rows.section: Tariff rules (Graubünden)
rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 780,440
rows.note: t) 11,0 % für das gesamte steuerbare Einkommen, wenn dieses Fr. 716 000.– (780 440.–)* übersteigt.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Graubünden (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, Art. 39 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Chur; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Chur; other communes in Graubünden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Chur; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Communal multiplier: Chur (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
rows.value: 88% of the cantonal tax at 100% (ESTV note 7)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Chur; other communes in Graubünden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
